items.title: Google, Meta and TikTok are all suing California to block social media law intended to help kids

items.lede: Law bans social media platforms from providing minors features such as autoplay that lead to compulsive use Google, Meta and TikTok have sued California to block enforcement of ⁠a new state law intended ⁠to limit the risk ​of addicting children under 16 to social media platforms. The law, known as Assembly Bill 1709, prohibits such platforms from offering underage children
items.title: Google, Meta and TikTok sue California to block law protecting children from addiction risk

items.lede: If it goes into effect next year, this California law would restrict social media access for children under 16.
items.title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law
